newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 465/466.25/$.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 465/466.25/$.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat in a quiet session at 465.00/466.25 bolivars per dollar as investors sat on the sidelines waiting for Wednesday's auction of Central Bank TEMs, traders said.
"Interbank trade was almost zero, with banks only bidding on behalf of moderate company demand (for dollars)," said one broker who saw trade possibly picking-up on Wednesday's TEM auction.
Traders said the Central Bank did not supply dollars during the day and only monitored the market.
